releaseNotes: Removed the residual neutral/OFF gap when a preloaded Signal Tower Alarm bank returns from PRI100 Alarm to sealed-in PRI10 Running.
Made Welcome DONE terminal for the current SYSTEM READY cycle so later Alarm activity cannot re-preempt a completed Welcome or emit another Welcome 0% PDO frame.
Added a guarded PDO-only winner handoff that suppresses only the one-scan ENO graph-order gap during a confirmed active Fast-Bank transition; intentional steady-state OFF remains fail-safe.
Preserved the existing dual-state Autoscale bank, PdoOutputCoordinator hardware-write SSOT, communication, ISDU, polling and protected runtime architecture.

en: Removed the residual neutral/OFF gap on PRI100 Alarm release back to sealed-in PRI10 Running.
Welcome DONE is now terminal for the current SYSTEM READY cycle and cannot be re-preempted by later Alarm activity.
A guarded PDO-only winner handoff bridges only the transient one-scan ENO gap while the previous hardware output is confirmed active.
Intentional OFF and fail-safe boundaries remain unchanged.
ko: PRI100 Alarm 해제 후 seal-in PRI10 Running으로 복귀할 때 남아 있던 Neutral/OFF 구간을 제거했습니다.
Welcome DONE을 현재 SYSTEM READY 주기의 종결 상태로 고정하여 이후 Alarm이 완료된 Welcome을 다시 PREEMPTED로 만들거나 Welcome 0% PDO를 재출력하지 않도록 했습니다.
이전 하드웨어 출력이 실제 ACTIVE로 확인되고 Fast Bank winner가 변경되는 경우에만 한 scan ENO 공백을 PDO-only direct handoff로 보정합니다.
사용자 의도 OFF와 fail-safe 경계의 Neutral 동작은 그대로 유지합니다.
